title: Albanese is losing support but could win voters’ trust back
teaser: Prime Minister of Australia Anthony Albanese is ending the last parliamentary week of 2026 amid falling approval ratings and growing discontent. According to an Essential Report poll, just over 30% of Australians approve of him, while 60% disapprove. With the cost of living high and international instability rising, the government has to choose where to cut spending and where to support investment. Another political challenge is the development of AI: the government wants to expand the industry, while some members of the public are concerned about the effects on jobs and culture.
